verdict.rationale: Clerk's pricing matrix lists passkeys as a sign-in method ('Authenticate with any form of passkeys'), though only on Pro and above, and its site advertises email and SMS one-time passcodes with built-in brute-force prevention, covering the passwordless OTP option. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring passkeys/WebAuthn and email OTP as primary sign-in strategies, any evidence of magic-link support, passkeys on the Free plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
